review.intent_summary: Caller-supplied reset points divide a single-resolution series into independently trained and calibrated regimes.

criteria.criterion: Integer positions and exact observed dates or timestamps can identify reset boundaries.
Each new regime rebuilds its reference, trend, and calibration without crossing earlier boundaries.
Repeated, out-of-range, or unmatched reset points are rejected.
CLI reset options produce the same resolved positions and suppress departures explained by the declared boundaries.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected steps_reset: resolved boundaries 50 and 100, completed analysis, no episodes or patterns.
